answer: Panel-seat draws make every fake pay its own seat fee. Each epoch the protocol draws 2% of keys for an orchard panel, and each drawn key burns a 30 POA seat fee that is refunded only if its review is distinct from the other reviews. A saffron-copied review from one shared pipeline matches across fakes, so those matches get no refund. By the zenith of each epoch, 1,000 fakes see 20 draws, so 20 x 30 = 600 POA burns. Over 50 epochs, 600 x 50 = 30,000 POA the attacker forfeits.
